data.one_liner: Zero-cost HTTP status codes as int extension types with functional helpers.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe HTTP status codes using Dart extension types for zero-cost abstraction over integers. Includes semantic helpers, range checks, pre-sorted category collections, random generation, and functional methods like when and map.
use_when: You want type-safe and readable HTTP status code checks in your Dart or Flutter project.
You need functional helpers and pattern matching over status codes without runtime overhead.
avoid_when: You only require a minimal set of standard integer constants and do not want any additional extension methods.
strengths: Zero-cost abstraction built on Dart 3.3 extension types.
Comprehensive coverage of IANA registered status codes and unofficial codes.
Rich set of semantic helpers like isCacheable and isRetryable.
weaknesses: Niche utility package focused solely on status codes.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and import it where needed.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general HTTP client functionality which includes basic status code handling constants if you do not need advanced functional status code features.

data.minimal_example:
print(200.isSuccess); // Prints true.
print(429.isRetryable); // Prints true.
